Reports

Every report Slate accepts for the current session. Green = uploaded in the last 48 hours, yellow = 2 – 7 days old, red = older than 7 days or never uploaded. Paste one in the Paste Data box below or drop a Team Screen PDF in the PDF Import card and this list updates automatically.

Paste Data

Paste any supported APA report here. First row = headers. Slate inspects the headers and auto-routes to the right importer. Currently selected session: —.

Each paste is identified by its header row. See the Reports card above for the full list and freshness status.

Supported player columns: Member Number, First Name, Nickname, Last Name, Email Address, Cell Phone, Home Phone, Work Phone, Alt Phone, Gender, 8-Ball Skill Level, 9-Ball Skill Level, Address 1, Address 2, City, State, Zip, Membership Revoked, Membership Promotion, Period Joined, Referred By, Date Marked Paid, Past Due, Deceased, Member Type, Date Started, Last Date Played 8-Ball, Last Date Played 9-Ball, Member Status. Unmapped columns are ignored.

County Lookup

Fills in missing county on player records using zippopotam.us (zip → lat/long) + FCC Census geocoder (lat/long → county). Free, no API keys, runs in your browser. One lookup per unique zip so 5,000 players with 600 unique zips = 600 HTTP calls.

PDF Import

Drag & drop (or click to browse) a Team Screen PDF. One team per page. Source: Nexus → Teams → Report List → Team Screen. Upserts teams and rebuilds Member rosters from each page's roster.
v1.8 workflow: Import Team Screen FIRST, then paste Team Data. Team Data captain resolution looks up captain names against each team's own roster (not a global player index), so a team must have its roster loaded before its captain can be resolved. Re-importing Team Screen automatically re-resolves captain rows: any captain whose member# vanished from the new roster is matched by name against the new roster, and the whole import hard-aborts (with no DB changes) if any name can't be resolved.

Mailing notification emails

Google Contacts sync

        

          Pushes every player on a Summer or Spring 2026 SPM roster
          (~1,000 people) into soldans@southportlandmetroapa.com's Google
          Contacts. Contacts are named First Nickname Last, carry all phones
          on file + email, and get the APA number + team names in the notes. Everything
          lands in the SPM APA contact group. Re-running updates changed
          numbers and adds new players — it never duplicates and never deletes, so
          lapsed players stay until you prune the group by hand. If a new player's
          number already lives on one of your own contacts, that contact is
          updated in place (league data wins, your extras are kept);
          a shared number with a clearly different name becomes a combined
          household contact (e.g. Kevin/Karen Blodgett).
        

        

          
          
          
        

        

        

          Scope: SPM only (operator 1). Runs through the apa-mailer GAS as soldans@ —
          no extra sign-in needed here. A sync of ~1,000 new contacts takes under a minute.
        

      

      

        
Duplicates

        

          Finds sync-created contacts that duplicate one you already had (matched by
          shared phone or email). Safe matches (same last name, same or
          prefix-matching first name, exactly one candidate) can be merged in bulk: your
          original contact keeps everything it has, gains the APA number and any missing
          numbers, and the duplicate is deleted (recoverable from Google Contacts trash
          for 30 days). Needs-review pairs — shared numbers with different
          names, usually spouses or ambiguous matches — are listed below with a per-pair
          Merge button. Merged contacts are never touched by future syncs.
